name: Flora Kueishii
original_name: フローラ・クエイシー
source: One of the Rio's attendants, Flora is a lovely and kind girl. Although she accompanies the prince, she is more concerned about Erika, with whom she was familiar for a long time. And yet, there is something she's not telling us...
translation: One of the Rio's attendants, Flora is a lovely and kind girl. Although she accompanies the prince, she is more concerned about Erika, with whom she was familiar for a long time. And yet, there is something she's not telling us...
